definitions.explanation: Creating or opening a new institution, facility, account, or service for the first time. Commonly used for offices, accounts, websites, courses, and facilities.

examples.japanese: {銀行|ぎんこう}{口座|こうざ}を{開設|かいせつ}する。
{会社|かいしゃ}のホームページを{開設|かいせつ}した。
examples.english: We set up the company's website.

examples.japanese: {市|し}は{災害|さいがい}{時|じ}の{避難所|ひなんじょ}として、{新|あたら}しい{施設|しせつ}を{開設|かいせつ}することを{決定|けってい}した。
examples.english: The city decided to establish a new facility to serve as an evacuation shelter in times of disaster.

notes:
USAGE:
{開設|かいせつ} is used for creating or opening something institutional or systematic — bank accounts, websites, offices, courses, facilities. It is more formal than simply {開|ひら}く and implies official establishment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {口座|こうざ}を{開設|かいせつ}する (to open an account)
- ホームページを{開設|かいせつ}する (to set up a website)
- {事務所|じむしょ}を{開設|かいせつ}する (to open an office)
- {講座|こうざ}を{開設|かいせつ}する (to establish a course)
- {窓口|まどぐち}を{開設|かいせつ}する (to open a service counter)

WATCH OUT:
{解説|かいせつ} (explanation, commentary) shares the same reading but has a completely different meaning and kanji.
